name: terra-rose
skin_notes: Amber Margins 'Warm Claude Editorial' skin applied over terra-rose scaffold mechanics. Parchment/ink/terracotta/amber world; no dark cosmic navy, indigo, or neon gradients. Harness audio/QA constants unchanged.

display.role: Chapter titles, act openers, literary quotations, channel title lockup (200-220px)

body.role: Editorial headings, on-screen quotations, labels; on-screen prose still capped at 3 words

label.role: Archival accession stamps, dates, coordinates, folio numbers (22-26px floor)

notes: AMBER MARGINS SKIN: parchment #F5EFEB / vellum #EAE0D0 grounds, ink #1E1813 type, terracotta #C2593F and amber #D9822B accents, brass #C89D42 details.
Pure black #000000 and pure white #FFFFFF are banned; contrast comes from warm tonal values.
At least 70% of every frame is parchment/vellum/ivory; terracotta + amber stay under 10% of frame area.
Type: Instrument Serif (display), EB Garamond (editorial body), JetBrains Mono (archival labels). Minimum rendered text 14px; on-screen text max 3 words per scene.
Layout: archival folio, museum passe-partout, cartographic graticules, paper grain 4-6% multiply, warm radial vignette.
Motion: macro dolly 1.000-1.035, no snap zooms or camera shake; heavy seams still follow harness tier rules.
Harness constants retained: voice en-US-ChristopherNeural @ +11%, ~180 WPM, 8:00-9:00, 20-35 scenes, -14.0 LUFS, -1.0 dBTP, BGM 0.34, SFX <= 0.35.
